scope: Local evidence mapping only; no transfer form, field validation, document authentication, authority, submission or receipt. Recheck the authorized Member Hub before any separately authorized operation.

registered work list.next_step: Identify the existing registered works in scope; unregistered works belong to new-work registration. Later inspect and verify the selected works in the transfer tool.

source member.next_step: Supply evidence identifying the Member whose registered works are in scope.

effective date.next_step: Supply evidence of the effective date for the rights being transferred.

authentic authority/termination evidence.next_step: Map authentic authorization to collect for the owner. For self-administered writers returning from an administrator, inspect relinquishment, agreement-term or termination-request documentation as applicable. The helper does not authenticate it.

transfer_review.document_disclosure: Supporting documents are forwarded to existing claimants. Review recipients and disclosure authority separately; the local packet does not send documents or grant consent.
transfer_review.source_release: Verify source relinquishment separately from a prepared packet or target acceptance.
transfer_review.target_acceptance: Verify target acceptance and effective scope separately from source release.
transfer_review.collection_tails: Preserve retained rights and old/new collection tails from the mandate evidence; no financial outcome is inferred.

review_basis: Document forwarding is stated in the linked MLC guidance. Separate release, acceptance and collection-tail checks preserve the local catalog transfer contract; they are not invented provider fields.
remaining_account_checks: Inspect the current Member Hub Catalog Transfer Tool and the actual account role and mandate before any separately authorized operation.
Record real receipts and readback only after the corresponding external event.
